dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's something off about this place...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: This unsettling feeling reminds me of a strange story I heard among the troops.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A strange story? Is it... scary?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: According to the story, there was an army that was marching through a deserted forest when they discovered a stockpile of delicious food.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: The troops were short on provisions, so they came to a halt and began to eat heartily. Before long, they suddenly noticed several pairs of blood-red eyes staring at them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh! Paimon's heard enough! What a scary story... *whimper*
